name: Banana Bread
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F. Grease a 9x5-inch loaf pan.
Whisk together the 1 3/4 cups all-purpose flour, 1/2 teaspoon baking soda, and 1/4 teaspoon salt in a large bowl.
In another bowl, whisk the 1 cup sugar, 2 eggs, 1 1/2 cups mashed ripe bananas until smooth.
Pour wet into dry and stir just until combined — a few lumps are fine. Fold in the 3/4 cup shredded zucchini.
Bake 60 minutes, until a toothpick in the center comes out clean. Cool 10 minutes, then turn out.
